Overview

The Hague is a city in South Holland with a population of 566,221. The seat of Dutch government and international law, offering a refined coastal lifestyle with a high concentration of expats and diplomats. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
